entities.summary: Sergey Vladimirovich Aleksashenko also transliterated as Alexashenko is a Russian economist and former government official. He was the deputy finance minister from 1993 to 1995, and first deputy chairman of the board of the Central Bank of Russia from 1995 to 1998. He was placed on a wanted list by the Russian government in November 2023.
